content: In-Depth Look Into Each Form Field Type Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000059648 What Are Field Types? The Field Type setting determines how a form field displays on the front end. Field types can be found under Edit View for any form: Select Fields Checkboxes To add options to a checkbox field, click Add Option . Specify the option display name and database variable. The database variable is created automatically but can be edited if needed. Front-end view: Drop-down List The same logic used for checkboxes applies to drop-down lists. Front-end view: Multiple Choice Radios The same logic used for checkboxes applies to radio buttons. Yes or No Important Note: For all select-type fields (Checkboxes, Radio Buttons, and Drop-down Lists), keyword searches will match the saved field label content. Text Inputs Custom HTML Email Address Section Title Important Note: Required Field and Database Variable settings are not applicable for this field type. Submit Form Button Important Note #1: Required Field and Database Variable settings are not applicable for this field type. Important Note #2: We recommend using Bootstrap button classes. Reference: Bootstrap Buttons In the example above, btn btn-danger was used to style the button. Fancy Fields File Upload Field Important: Maximum file size: 10 MB Default availability: Listing – Additional Details – Member form This field can be used on other forms with the File Uploads for Forms add-on. Additional Information: How to Use or Modify the Member Upload CV or Brochure Field Froala Text Editors Froala Text Editor – Basic Froala Text Editor – Image Upload Froala Text Editor – Image Upload + Pre-Made Elements Froala Text Editor – Access Media Manager Full details are available here: Froala Text Editor: Versions and Upload Capabilities For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
